channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: MOD removes need to request permission for pets in SFA
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed that service families will no longer need to seek permission to keep a pet at home, as part of reforms under the Defence Housing Strategy. The post MOD removes need to request permission for pets in SFA first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Exercise Hyperion Storm validates RAF spec ops readiness
item.description: Exercise Hyperion Storm has confirmed Royal Air Force readiness to support the upcoming UK leadership role in the NATO Allied Reaction Force Special Operations Component from July 2026, the service stated. The post Exercise Hyperion Storm validates RAF spec ops readiness first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: U.S. Navy opens first F-16 maintenance line
item.description: The U.S. Navy has established a new depot-level maintenance programme for their F-16 Viper aircraft The post U.S. Navy opens first F-16 maintenance line first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: U.S. Navy fires warship Captain during exercise
item.description: The U.S. Navy has fired the commanding officer of the guided-missile destroyer USS Mason, citing a loss of confidence in his ability to command. The post U.S. Navy fires warship Captain during exercise first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: British and French troops train for NATO rapid response role
item.description: British and French soldiers have taken part in joint training in France aimed at improving interoperability and demonstrating readiness to defend NATO territory, the Ministry of Defence stated. The post British and French troops train for NATO rapid response role first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Royal Navy submarine trainees pass out at HMNB Clyde
item.description: Thirty-nine Royal Navy submarine qualifying students have completed the classroom-based dry phase of their training at HMNB Clyde, the service stated. The post Royal Navy submarine trainees pass out at HMNB Clyde first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: HII explores AI shipbuilding welding partnership
item.description: American shipbuilder HII has signed a memorandum of understanding with Path Robotics to explore the integration of artificial intelligence-driven welding technology into its shipbuilding operations. The post HII explores AI shipbuilding welding partnership first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Kongsberg to supply RS4 weapon stations for CAVS fleet
item.description: Patria has signed a contract with Kongsberg Defence & Aerospace for the delivery of PROTECTOR RS4 remote weapon stations for more than 300 Patria 6x6 armoured vehicles under the multinational Common Armoured Vehicle System (CAVS) programme. The post Kongsberg to supply RS4 weapon stations for CAVS fleet first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Britain delivers more than 85,000 drones to Ukraine
item.description: More than 85,000 military drones had been delivered between April and October 2025, against an annual target of 100,000 for the financial year. The post Britain delivers more than 85,000 drones to Ukraine first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK joins NATO ballistic missile defence effort
item.description: NATO Allies including the United Kingdom have agreed to launch a new multinational project aimed at strengthening defence against ballistic missile threats. The post UK joins NATO ballistic missile defence effort first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
